title: Tidewater Ewer
facts: Thrown in two sections and joined at the shoulder. The cobalt wave pattern was brushed on before glazing. A hairline repair at the spout was made in the 20th century.

title: Lantern of the Night Ferry
facts: Carried on the Corrin Bay night ferry until the service ended in 1902. The glass chimney is a replacement. The foundry mark is stamped under the base.

title: Sampler with Seven Birds
facts: Worked in cross stitch and satin stitch. Seven birds sit above an alphabet and the maker's name. The linen has faded unevenly along the left edge.

title: Surveyor's Folding Rule
facts: Marked in inches and tenths. The brass hinges are original. Initials 'T.W.' are scratched into one leaf.
provenance: Purchased from a Corrin Bay dealer, 1961

title: Bell Buoy Clapper
facts: Removed from the Skerry Point bell buoy during its 1974 refit. The surface is heavily pitted by salt water. It was cast in a single pour.
